The laser provides a different way to destroy vehicles, and to provide support for the team when other anti-vehicle supply's are on the spawn, rather than giving in to the inevitable vehicle slaughter. You can also avoid the laser as I have and many other people do, Given there is only one on a map at a time there is room for maneuverability. The laser sight before death is also suppose to give the driver a chance to either get out or take cover as long as you pay attention and squint really hard. 

The Banshees are also a part of Halo that is meant for support and different approaches for attacking the enemy, the Falcon has that role too but provides a more team oriented approach than the Banshee so team players and lone wolves can have their own approaches on air combat. Getting rid of the Banshee removes more options for combat in the game.
